test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The traditional folk dance 'Kunbi' belongs to which of the following regions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kunbi** dance is a traditional folk dance belonging to the state of **Goa**, performed by the **Kunbi community**, who are the **original settlers** or **tribal inhabitants** of the **Konkan** region.
 
• It is predominantly a **women-led** dance form, characterized by its **simple yet fast-paced** movements that reflect the **social life** and **cultural traditions** of the tribe.
 
• Unlike many other folk dances that center around **religious deities**, the **Kunbi dance** is unique as it primarily focuses on **social themes**, though it is often performed during festivals like **Shigmo** and other social gatherings.
 
• The performers wear a traditional **Kunbi saree**, which is usually **red or checkered**, knotted on the **right shoulder** and worn slightly above the **ankles** to allow for rhythmic footwork.
 
• The dance is accompanied by the rhythmic beats of traditional musical instruments, most notably the **Ghumat** (an earthen pot drum) and the **Shamel**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Goa**:

 
 
• Other prominent folk dances of **Goa** include **Fugdi**, **Dhalo**, **Dekhni**, **Corridinho**, and **Mando**.
 
• The **Mando** is a beautiful blend of **Indian** and **Western** musical influences, reflecting the **Portuguese** legacy in the **coastal state**.
 
 
 
• **Assam**:
 
 
• This **North-Eastern** state is famous for the **Bihu** dance, performed during the **Rongali Bihu** festival to celebrate the **harvest**.
 
• **Sattriya**, which originated in the **15th century**, is the **classical dance** form of **Assam**, introduced by the saint **Mahapurusha Sankaradeva**.
 
 
 
• **Mizoram**:
 
 
• The **Cheraw** dance, also known as the **Bamboo Dance**, is the most iconic folk dance of **Mizoram**, involving the rhythmic clapping of **bamboo staves**.
 
• Other dances like **Khuallam** and **Chheihlam** are performed during community feasts and celebrations.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat**:
 
 
• **Garba** and **Dandiya Raas** are the world-renowned folk dances of **Gujarat**, performed with great enthusiasm during the **nine nights** of the **Navratri** festival.
 
• The **Tippani** dance is another unique form, traditionally performed by **women laborers** in the **Saurashtra** region using **long sticks** to beat the floor.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Kunbi saree**, which is the attire for this dance, has seen a modern revival and is considered a symbol of **Goan heritage**. It is made of **sturdy cotton** to withstand **agricultural work**.
 
• The **Kunbi community** is traditionally an **agrarian** society, and their dance movements often mimic the **sowing** and **harvesting** processes.
 
• Despite over **450 years** of **Portuguese rule** in **Goa**, the **Kunbi dance** has largely retained its **indigenous tribal** purity and **traditional rhythm**.
 
• Efforts by the **Government of Goa** and **cultural organizations** have helped in promoting the **Kunbi folk dance** at national platforms like the **Republic Day Parade** in **New Delhi**.
